nav.label: Portal
nav.unread: {count, plural, one {# new message} other {# new messages}}

errors.inviteInvalid: This invitation is no longer valid. Ask your professional for a new one.

password.short: The password must have at least 8 characters.
password.long: The password can have at most 128 characters.
password.common: That password is easy to guess. Choose another one.
password.personal: Don't use your CPF or date of birth as your password.

errors.acceptRequired: Confirm that you read how your data is handled.
errors.sessionUnavailable: This session can no longer be answered.
errors.messagesOff: Messages are turned off for you. Contact the practice through the agreed channels.
errors.messageLong: The message can have up to {max} characters.
errors.tooMany: Too many attempts. Wait {minutes} minutes and try again.
errors.identityMismatch: The details don't match our records. Check them and try again.
errors.tooManyMessages: You sent many messages in the last hour. Wait a bit: the conversation is for notes, not real-time chat.

login.metaTitle: Sign in to the patient portal
login.title: Patient portal
login.description: Sign in with your CPF (Brazilian tax ID) and the password you created on your first access.
login.forgotHelp: Ask your professional for a new access link. With it, you create a new password.
login.firstAccessHelp: Use the link the practice sent you. There you confirm your details and create the password.

invite.invalidDescription: This link was already used or is past its 72-hour limit. Ask your professional for a new one.
invite.goLogin: I already have a password: sign in
invite.title: Create your access
invite.description: Patient portal of {workspace}. Confirm your details and choose a password.
invite.cpfHint: Your CPF will be your portal login.
invite.passwordHint: At least 8 characters. An easy-to-remember phrase works great.
invite.accept: I understand that the portal keeps my messages and records confidential, that replies aren't immediate and that it isn't an emergency channel.

week.unreadMessages: {count, plural, one {You have # new message} other {You have # new messages}}
week.joinLater: The button to join the online session shows up {minutes} minutes before the time.
week.rescheduleSent: Reschedule request sent. The practice will get in touch.
week.willYouCome: Are you coming to this session?
week.rescheduleNote: Tell us the best day or time for you (optional)
week.noSessions: No sessions scheduled. When there is one, it shows up here with the video call link.
week.checkinDescription: It takes 30 seconds. Your entries help talk about the week in your next session. They aren't read right away.
week.noHighlights: Nothing here yet. Tasks, reminders and materials agreed in session show up here.
week.taskNotePlaceholder: How did it go? It's okay if you couldn't (optional)
week.checkinLow: If you need help now, call CVV at 188 (24 hours) or SAMU at 192.

checkin.question: How are you feeling?
checkin.updateQuestion: You already checked in today. Want to update it?
checkin.notesHint: This space isn't read right away. If you need help now, call 188 (CVV).

messages.title: Messages
messages.defaultNotice: Use it for notes and arrangements between sessions. Replies may take a few days.
messages.emergency: This channel isn't for emergencies. In a crisis, call CVV at 188 (24 hours) or SAMU at 192. In immediate danger, call 190 or go to an emergency room.
messages.privacy: It's kept confidential in your record.
messages.disabled: Messages are turned off. Contact the practice through the agreed channels.

account.installDescription: On your phone, open the browser menu and tap "Add to Home screen". The portal opens like an app, without the address bar.
account.passwordDescription: After changing it, you stay signed in only on this device.

pro.title: Portal · {name}
pro.description: What the patient sees between sessions: conversation, tasks and materials, check-ins and session replies.
pro.messagesDescription: Messages through the portal. It isn't an emergency channel: the patient sees this notice.
pro.recordHint: It's kept as a record of care. Copy what's clinically relevant to the record.
pro.activateFirst: To chat, the patient must activate access through the invitation.
pro.highlightsDescription: Tasks between sessions, reminders and materials (links). They show up on the patient's home screen.
pro.highlightTitlePlaceholder: E.g.: Thought record 3 times this week
pro.accessDescription: Generate an invitation and send it through your WhatsApp. The patient confirms the date of birth, enters the CPF and creates a password. Then they sign in on the portal's Sign in page (/portal/entrar).
pro.checkinsAvg: {count, plural, one {# entry} other {# entries}} · average mood {avg} of 5
pro.noCheckins: No check-ins in the last 30 days.
pro.revoked: Access revoked. The portal no longer opens for the patient.
pro.messagesOff: Messages turned off. The patient sees the notice in the portal.

errors.messageLong: The message can have up to {max} characters.
errors.urlInvalid: Invalid link. Use an address starting with https://.
errors.onlyOwner: Only the owner or an admin can change this notice.
errors.needIdentity: Add the patient's date of birth or CPF before generating the invitation.

invite.whatsappText: Hi, {name}! This is your access to the patient portal, where you see your sessions, the video call link and can leave notes between sessions. The link is valid for 72 hours: {link}
invite.whatsappReset: Hi, {name}! Here's the link to create a new password in the patient portal. It's valid for 72 hours: {link}
invite.ready: Invitation ready. Valid until {date} and can be used only once.
invite.onceHint: This link only shows up now. If you lose it, generate another one (the previous one stops working).
invite.needIdentity: To generate the invitation, add the patient's date of birth or CPF: that's what they confirm when opening the link.

inbox.title: Patient portal
inbox.description: {count, plural, =0 {No patients with the portal active yet.} one {# patient with the portal active.} other {# patients with the portal active.}} Enable access from each patient's profile.
inbox.requestsDescription: The patient asked for another time. After agreeing and rescheduling in the calendar, mark it as handled.
inbox.emptyDescription: When a patient sends a message through the portal, the conversation shows up here.
inbox.noticeDescription: Shown to the patient above the conversation. Set realistic times: the portal isn't real-time care.
inbox.noticePlaceholder: E.g.: I reply within 2 business days, Monday to Friday.
inbox.legacyTitle: {count, plural, one {# patient with the old link} other {# patients with the old link}}
inbox.legacyDescription: The portal now has a password. These patients got the old link and haven't created a password yet: generate a new invitation for each one.

pro.revokeConfirm: Revoke {name}'s portal access? To enable it again, generate an invitation.
pro.cpfFromPatient: CPF entered by the patient on first access (the record has no CPF). Check it before using it on receipts.

legacy.title: This link has changed
legacy.description: The portal now uses CPF and password. If you already created your password, use the sign-in screen. If not, ask your professional for a new access link.
